categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Refactors wallet internals across src/wallet/ files, extracting migration logic out of wallet.cpp into migration.cpp.
categories.rationale: Extracting migration logic out of wallet.cpp improves maintainability of the oversized wallet implementation. The PR reduces wallet.cpp by over 800 lines by moving legacy BDB migration routines into dedicated files, clarifying module boundaries without altering user-facing wallet behavior.
